channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Farmaajo oo soo dhaweeyay booqashada Museveni, farriin siyaasadeedna u diray hoggaanka Soomaaliya
item.description: Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo ayaa soo dhaweeyay booqashada la filayo in Madaxweynaha Uganda Yoweri Museveni uu ku yimaado Muqdisho, wuxuuna hoggaanka dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan Dastuuri ah.

item.title: XIISADDA SIYAASADEED: Xildhibaan Dayah Axmed Cumar oo eedeymo culus u jeediyay Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya
item.description: Xildhibaan Dayah Axmed Cumar oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay Facebook ku eedeeyay Guddoomiyaha Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jamac TikTok), inuu khatar ku yahay dalka iyo jaajuusnimo. Eedeymahan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin.

item.title: Udinese: Xaaladda caafimaad ee guddoomiyaha kooxda, Gianpaolo Pozzo, oo soo fiicnaanaysa
item.description: Kooxda Udinese ayaa Talaadada bayaan ku sheegtay in xaaladda caafimaad ee guddoomiyaheeda Gianpaolo Pozzo, oo isbitaal loogu daweynayo oof-wareen, ay si tartiib ah u soo hagaagayso.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn ku soo rogay kooxda Xuutiyiinta iyo 4 ka mid ah saraakiisheeda
item.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Talaadada ku dhawaaqday cunaqabateyn ka dhan ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen iyo 4 ka mid ah saraakiisheeda, iyadoo ku eedeysay gardarro cusub oo ka dhan ah Yemen gudaheeda iyo Sacuudi Carabiya.

item.title: Wasiirka Caafimaadka: Ku dhowaad 400 xarumood oo caafimaad ayaa xirmay kadib joojinta kaalmada USAID
item.description: Wasiirka Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada Soomaaliya, Cali Xaaji Aadan, ayaa Talaadada sheegay in ku dhowaad 400 xarumood oo caafimaad iyo dhowr xarumood oo guurguura ay shaqada joojiyeen, kadib markii ay dhammaatay maalgelintii ay ka heli jireen hay'adda USAID ee Mareykanka.

item.title: Crystal Palace Women oo 3 dhibcood laga jaray WSL kadib isbeddel ciyaartoy oo xeerka ka baxsan
item.description: Kooxda haweenka ee Crystal Palace ayaa 3 dhibcood laga jaray horyaalka Women's Super League (WSL), kadib markii ay ciyaartoy ku beddeleen 4 fursadood oo kala duwan ciyaartii ay September 1-0 kaga badiyeen Everton.

item.title: Soomaaliya oo markii ugu horreysay hirgelisay nidaamka Lambarka Aqoonsiga Canshuur-bixiyaha (TIN)
item.description: Hay'adda Dakhliga Qaranka ee Soomaaliya ayaa hirgelisay nidaamka Lambarka Aqoonsiga Canshuur-bixiyaha (TIN), kaas oo loogu talagalay casriyeynta maamulka canshuuraha iyo fududeynta diiwaangelinta ganacsiyada.

item.title: Villarreal oo waayay Nathan Saliba, oo qalliin looga samaynayo dhaawac canqowga ah
item.description: Kooxda Villarreal ayaa Talaadada xaqiijisay in khadka dhexe ee reer Canada, Nathan Saliba, uu qalliin u galayo kadib dhaawac seedaha canqowga bidix ah oo uu ku qaaday tababar.

item.title: Tababaraha Augsburg, Manuel Baum, oo hal ciyaar laga mamnuucay kadib kaarkii cas ee Mainz
item.description: Maxkamadda Isboortiga ee Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Jarmalka (DFB) ayaa tababaraha FC Augsburg, Manuel Baum, ku ciqaabtay mamnuucid hal ciyaar ah, kadib dhacdooyinkii ciyaartii guriga ay kooxdiisu la ciyaartay Mainz 05.

item.title: Torino oo waayi doonta Ardian Ismajli ugu yaraan 3 toddobaad kadib laba dhaawac
item.description: Daafaca dhexe ee Torino, Ardian Ismajli, ayaa la ogaaday inuu dhaawac ka soo gaaray murqaha bowdada bidix isla markaana uu jabay gacanta midig, ciyaartii Sabtidii ay kooxdiisu la ciyaartay Napoli.

item.title: Morocco oo CAS u gudbisay cabasho ku saabsan wicitaan, saacado ka hor go'aanka AFCON 2025
item.description: Xiriirka Boqortooyada Kubadda Cagta Morocco (FRMF) ayaa Maxkamadda Garqaadka Isboortiga (CAS) u diray warqad rasmi ah oo uu kaga warbixinayo dhacdo, saacado ka hor inta aan la soo saarin go'aanka kama dambaysta ah ee cidda ku guulaysatay koobka Qaramada Afrika 2025.

item.title: Mareykanka iyo Qatar oo Washington kaga wada hadlay xaaladda amni iyo siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya
item.description: Mareykanka iyo Qatar ayaa arrimaha Soomaaliya ku daray ajandaha wada-hadalladoodii istaraatiijiga ahaa ee siddeedaad, kuwaas oo 23 November 2026 ka dhacay magaalada Washington.

item.title: Somali Airlines oo la filayo inay 10 December dib u bilowdo duulimaadyada kadib in ka badan 35 sano
item.description: Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya, Maxamed Faarax Nuux, ayaa shaaciyay in shirkadda diyaaradaha qaranka ee Somali Airlines ay dib u bilaabi doonto duulimaadyadeeda 10 December 2026.

item.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo caawa kulan degdeg ah isugu yeeray Golaha Wasiirrada
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la sheegay inuu caawa kulan degdeg ah isugu yeeray Golaha Wasiirrada, kaas oo la filayo in looga hadlo xisbiyada siyaasadeed iyo qorshe la sheegay in wasiirka aan xisbi ku biirin laga doonayo inuu xilka ka tago.

item.title: Werder Bremen oo khasaaraha dabka iyo burburka taageerayaasha HSV ee derby-ga u gudbinaysa Hamburg
item.description: Werder Bremen ayaa sheegtay in taageerayaasha Hamburger SV ay kulankii Axadda ee Nordderby kadib dab ka shideen garoonka Weserstadion iyo musqulo ay burburiyeen, isla markaana kharashka qiyaastii 10,000 euro ah loo gudbin doono HSV.

item.title: Ferran Torres oo qiyaastii 7 milyan oo euro ku iibsaday dhismaha xafiisyada Valencia ee ku dhow Mestalla
item.description: Weeraryahanka PSG Ferran Torres, oo ku soo koray akadeemiyada Valencia, ayaa qiyaastii 7 milyan oo euro ku iibsaday dhismaha ay ku yaallaan xafiisyada kooxda Valencia CF, ee ku dhow garoonka Mestalla.

item.title: Malaysia oo ku dhawaaqday inay in ka badan 6,500 qaxooti Rohingya ah dib ugu celinayso Myanmar
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Malaysia Anwar Ibrahim ayaa Talaadadii baarlamaanka u sheegay in dalkiisu uu in ka badan 6,500 qaxooti Rohingya ah dib ugu celin doono Myanmar, shan maalmood kadib markii Maxkamadda Caddaaladda Caalamka ay xukuntay in Myanmar ay xasuuq ka gashay Rohingya.

item.title: De Bruyne oo ka cadhooday saxaafadda Talyaaniga: 'Qofna xaq uma laha inuu ka hadlo noloshayda gaarka ah'
item.description: Kevin De Bruyne ayaa kahor kulanka Napoli iyo Manchester City ee Champions League dhaleeceeyay warbaahinta Talyaaniga, isagoo ka cabanaya sawirro guriga qoyskiisa laga qaaday iyo weerarro lagu qaaday xaaskiisa.

item.title: Neymar oo garsooraha si adag u dhaleeceeyay kadib markii Santos ay 2-0 guriga uga lumisay Grêmio
item.description: Kabtanka Santos Neymar ayaa Isniintii habeenkii ku tilmaamay garsoorka kulanka ay Grêmio 2-0 uga badisay horyaalka Brazil mid aan la aqbali karin, isagoo ka cabanaya xumaatooyinka loo geystay.

item.title: Muranka Musiala oo sii xoogaystay: FIFPRO iyo ururka ciyaartoyda Jarmalka oo dhaleeceeyay Bayern Munich
item.description: Ururrada ciyaartoyda ayaa Bayern Munich ku eedeeyay inay cadaadis ku saarayso Jamal Musiala si uu u aqbalo dhimista mushaarka, halka warbixin cusub ay sheegtay in suuxdin uu la kulmay bishii April aan la shaacin.

item.title: Oklahoma City Thunder oo 125-120 looga adkaaday Indiana inkastoo Gilgeous-Alexander uu dhaliyay 38 dhibcood
item.description: Oklahoma City Thunder ayaa Isniintii 125-120 ku lumisay kulankii ay ku booqatay Indiana Pacers, iyadoo Shai Gilgeous-Alexander uu dhaliyay 38 dhibcood, taas oo kooxda hoos u dhigtay kaalinteeda horyaalka.

item.title: San Antonio Spurs oo 123-107 ku garaacay Kings, iyadoo Wembanyama uu seegay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay xilli ciyaareedkan
item.description: Victor Wembanyama ayaa Isniintii seegay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee xilli ciyaareedkan, balse San Antonio Spurs ayaa la'aantiis 123-107 kaga adkaatay Sacramento Kings garoonkooda.

item.title: Barcelona iyo Florentino Pérez oo Arbacada maxkamad isugu imanaya khilaafka kiiska Negreira
item.description: Kooxda FC Barcelona iyo madaxweynaha Real Madrid, Florentino Pérez, ama qareennada uu u igmado, ayaa Arbacada 25 November 2026 maxkamadaha Madrid ugu kulmaya fadhi dib-u-heshiisiin ah, kadib markii Barcelona ay dacwad ka gudbisay hadallo uu ka sheegay kiiska Negreira.

item.title: Turkiga oo Golaha Ammaanka u sheegay inuu diyaarinayo nidaam cusub oo lagu sugayo marinka Badda Madow
item.description: Ergayga joogtada ah ee Turkiga u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Ahmet Yıldız, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu uu ka shaqaynayo nidaam cusub oo lagu sugayo badbaadada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Madow, si aan loo carqaladayn sahayda cuntada iyo waxsoosaarka beeraha.

item.title: Commanders oo ilbiriqsiyadii u dambeeyay 22-20 ku garaacay Bengals, Jayden Daniels oo hoggaamiyay
item.description: Washington Commanders ayaa Isniintii habeenkii 22-20 kaga adkaatay Cincinnati Bengals kulankii Monday Night Football, kadib field goal 26 yaard ah oo Drew Stevens dhaliyay iyadoo waqtigu dhammaanayo.

item.title: Madaxa WHO, Tedros, oo booqasho ku jooga Cuba xilli nidaamka caafimaadka dalkaasi uu sii xumaanayo
item.description: Agaasimaha Guud ee Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunka (WHO), Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, ayaa booqasho 3 maalmood ah ku jooga Cuba, halkaas oo uu ku eegayo nidaamka caafimaadka oo ay saameyn ku yeesheen cunaqabateynta Mareykanka iyo yaraanta shidaalka iyo korontada.

item.title: Chicago Cubs iyo Trevor Rogers oo la sheegay inay ku heshiiyeen qandaraas 5 sano ah oo $120 milyan ah
item.description: Kooxda baseball-ka ee Chicago Cubs iyo tuuraha bidixda ah Trevor Rogers ayaa la sheegay inay ku heshiiyeen qandaraas 5 sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay $120 milyan, inkastoo kooxdu aysan weli si rasmi ah u shaacin.

item.title: Toronto Maple Leafs oo 4-2 ku garaacay Islanders, soo afjaray 9 guuldarro oo xiriir ah
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs ayaa Isniintii 4-2 kaga adkaatay New York Islanders horyaalka NHL, taas oo soo afjartay 9 guuldarro oo xiriir ah oo kooxdu la kulantay.

item.title: Mexico: Mareykanka oo diyaarad basaas ah oo aan duuliye lahayn u duuliyay qabashada ganacsade daroogo oo caan ah
item.description: Saraakiisha amniga Mexico ayaa Isniintii sheegay in Mareykanku uu dhulka Mexico dul marsiiyay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo basaasnimo, si ay uga caawiso raadinta iyo qabashada Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, oo loo yaqaan 'El Chapo Isidro'.

item.title: SEC oo 3 December shir gaar ah u qabanaysa go'aanka in LSU laga saaro, khilaafka RJ Luis dartiis
item.description: Shirarka SEC ee isboortiga jaamacadaha Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii dukumiinti maxkamadeed ku sheegay inay 3 December shir gaar ah ku eegi doonaan in xubinnimada jaamacadda LSU la joojiyo, iyadoo khilaafka ciyaaryahanka kubbadda koleyga RJ Luis uu gaaray heer cusub.
